source.title: Committee for Consultations on the Situation in Andhra Pradesh, Report, December 2010
source.provenance: Third-party hosted copy of government committee report; directly opened and text inspected; NOT original signed 1956 agreement or government-hosted PDF
source.sections: Chapter 1 §1.1.11, reproduced 20 February 1956 agreement, printed pp 10-13

specific_evidence.content: Common administrative expenditure shared proportionately; remaining Telangana income reserved for Telangana development; five-year review.
Protect and improve Telangana education; Telangana colleges or one-third statewide admissions as advantageous.
Future service recruitment on population basis for both regions.
Agricultural land sales in Telangana subject to Regional Council control, not an absolute prohibition.
Regional Council intended for Telangana development.
Regional Council role included planning, irrigation, industry and recruitment.

source.historical_implementation_caveat: Report §1.1.12 distinguishes the proposed statutory Regional Council from the subsequently constituted Regional Committee; avoid conflation.

current_question.stem: Which statement about the Gentlemen’s Agreement is most accurate?

options.B: It was intended to safeguard Telangana interests around merger

current_question.assessment_quality: Correct key but three implausible unrelated distractors.

proposed_question_not_published.stem: Under the 1956 Gentlemen’s Agreement, how was Telangana's remaining regional income to be treated after its proportional share of common administration costs?

options.A: Reserved for development of the Telangana area
options.B: Transferred in full to the common administration budget
options.C: Divided equally between Andhra and Telangana irrespective of regional receipts
options.D: Permanently assigned to the proposed Regional Council as an unrestricted cash grant

proposed_question_not_published.evidence: Agreement clause 1 directly supports A; clause 1 contradicts B and C; clauses 1,9,11 do not establish an unrestricted cash grant to Council as D asserts.
proposed_question_not_published.limitation: Distractors still need independent pedagogical review; question is original practice, not an official PYQ.
